findings.description: IDispatcher interface defined with all required methods
findings.notes: All methods present: initialize, shutdown, lookup, lookup_async, batch_lookup, check, remove, populate, prepare_store, commit_store, cancel_store, touch, promote_to_memory_tier, clear_memory_tier, flush_to_ssd

findings.description: DispatcherError covers all failure modes
findings.notes: NotInitialized, KeyNotFound, AlreadyExists, AllocationFailed, IoError, Timeout, InvalidParameter

findings.description: populate() allocates memory-tier slot, DMA copies from GPU, registers in dispatch map, enqueues write-through, evicts if needed
Background writer uses peek() (no LRU refresh) and writes to SSD via extent manager
findings.notes: process_write_job calls mt.peek() then writes via segmented I/O

findings.description: Memory-tier entry remains accessible after write-through completion
findings.notes: Only calls convert_to_storage; never removes from memory-tier on write completion

findings.description: lookup() handles MemoryTier (memcpy_h2d_async + touch), BlockDevice (promote_and_serve), Staging (DMA)
findings.notes: Uses warm stream with fallback to sync dma_copy_to_device

findings.description: lookup returns KeyNotFound when key does not exist
check() returns bool without data transfer
remove() frees memory-tier slot, extent, and dispatch map entry
Uses define_component! macro exposing only IDispatcher
Receptacles for ILogger, IDispatchMap, IGpuServices, ISPDKEnv, IMemoryTier. DispatcherConfig includes poller_base_cpu
findings.notes: set_actor_cpu called when poller_cpu is set

findings.description: initialize() validates dispatch_map and memory_tier before proceeding
Appropriate locking via IDispatchMap trait contract
findings.notes: Thread safety enforced by trait design (Send+Sync bounds)

findings.description: shutdown() drains writer, checkpoints extent managers, shuts down block devices in reverse
findings.notes: Two-phase shutdown: signal all actors, then join

findings.description: N block devices with N extent managers, each EM on its own data device
Passes data_disk_size and computed FormatParams to each extent manager format()
Background writer silently drops failed jobs
findings.notes: Returns early on extent allocation or I/O failure

findings.description: remove() does not block on write-through
findings.notes: No flush call before removal

findings.description: I/O segmented via io_segmenter respecting MDTS. Pipeline uses sliding window with tag-based completion routing. Periodic sync every PIPELINE_RING_SIZE=8. batch_lookup uses 16/num_queues per thread
findings.notes: Both zero-copy single and multi-object variants implemented

findings.description: prepare_store validates size>0, AlreadyExists, registers in dispatch map, reserves extent, returns DMA buffer
commit_store writes buffer with MDTS segmentation, publishes extent, transitions to block-device state
cancel_store drops PendingWrite (auto-abort), removes dispatch map entry
touch() updates dispatch map timestamp AND refreshes memory-tier LRU without DMA
findings.notes: Spec was updated to include memory-tier LRU refresh (see spec FR-023 text)

findings.description: evict_for_space uses sparse-probe + shard-targeted LRU (evict_lru_for_key). Every 8th attempt probes oldest_keys(4) + is_evictable. Bounded by configurable max_attempts (default 2048)
format_on_init flag; when false, recovers extent managers and reconstructs dispatch map via for_each_extent
findings.notes: Logs count and elapsed time

findings.description: On BlockDevice lookup, re-inserts to memory-tier and re-registers as MemoryTier with ssd_offset preserved
Background SSD evictor started if threshold > 0.0 and drives configured; joined during shutdown()
Evictor checks combined SSD utilization with configurable interval
Evictor evicts BlockDevice entries using oldest_keys(batch_size), stops below low_watermark
Evictor skips MemoryTier entries; dm.remove() failure handled gracefully
DispatcherConfig includes all required fields with correct defaults
findings.notes: ssd_eviction_threshold=0.9, low_watermark=0.8, batch_size=64, interval_secs=5, max_eviction_attempts=2048

findings.description: initialize() calls register_host_memory on memory-tier pool; caches ClientChannels per drive
findings.notes: Registration failure logged as warning

findings.description: shutdown() calls unregister_host_memory before memory-tier teardown
lookup_async returns GpuStream; synchronous lookup delegates to lookup_async + stream_synchronize
findings.notes: For non-memory-tier paths a null stream is returned

findings.description: Spec requires pool of 4 warm CUDA streams stored as RwLock<Vec<u64>>. Code allocates single stream stored as AtomicU64
findings.notes: Single warm stream instead of multi-stream pool. batch_lookup creates per-thread streams for cold path but does not use pre-allocated pool for hot path round-robin distribution as specified.

findings.description: clear_memory_tier() evicts all via evict_lru() loop, transitions to BlockDevice or removes on failure, returns count
findings.notes: IMemoryTier trait also provides clear() method

findings.description: Spec requires deferred batch sync for hot entries (issue all async copies first, synchronize all streams once at end). Code synchronizes per-key in the hot path
findings.notes: Per-key stream_synchronize in MemoryTier branch of batch_lookup prevents the throughput benefit of deferred batch synchronization

findings.description: promote_to_memory_tier() reads BlockDevice entries via pipelined_ssd_to_dram_only, refreshes MemoryTier/Staging timestamps, silently skips missing keys
findings.notes: Errors logged via ILogger but not propagated

findings.description: pipelined_ssd_to_dram_only and pipelined_multi_ssd_to_dram_only both implemented
findings.notes: promote_to_memory_tier uses single-object variant per-entry; multi variant exists but unused currently

unspecced_findings.description: Blocks until all background write-through jobs complete. Defined in IDispatcher interface but has no corresponding FR-* requirement.
Comprehensive timing instrumentation for cold/hot/populate paths. No FR-* covers observability or metrics collection.
